name: adversarial_spouse
input_text: I started cooking for myself last year. It began as a way to save money. Then I realized I actually enjoyed the process of chopping vegetables and experimenting with spices. Cooking became a form of meditation after work. I would put on music and lose track of time. Some dishes turned out great and others were disasters but I learned from each attempt. Now I cook almost every evening. It has changed how I think about food and about my own patience. I never thought I would find so much satisfaction in something so ordinary.

sections.title: How it began
paragraphs: I started cooking for myself last year to save money. At first it was just a chore, another thing to get through after a long day. But I realized I actually enjoyed the process.
My husband encouraged me to keep going even when dishes turned out badly. He said the disasters were part of the learning.
